# VartiMax Consultant (Visa & Admissions Consultancy Islamabad)

> VartiMax Consultant is an embassy file preparation and visa advisory consultancy headquartered in Islamabad, Pakistan, specializing in Schengen, Canada, USA, UK, UAE, and Umrah visas with a 90% documented success rate.

## Key Facts
- **Location**: Office 78, Basement, Gaga Downtown, Islamabad, Pakistan
- **Helpline / WhatsApp**: +92 340 1207525
- **Email**: vartimaxconsultant@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://vartimaxconsultancy.vercel.app/
- **Success Rate**: 90% Embassy File Acceptance Rate

## Core Services
- **Schengen Visit Visa**: Cover letter drafting, €30,000 Schengen insurance, verified dummy ticket/hotel bookings, day-wise itineraries for 29 European countries.
- **Canada Visa & Study Permit**: SDS vs Non-SDS filing, GIC assistance, Statement of Purpose (SOP) crafting, ties to home country proof.
- **USA B1/B2 & F1 Visa**: DS-160 filling, mock interview coaching for US Embassy Islamabad, ties establishment.
- **UK Student & Visit Visa**: CAS letter verification, 28-day maintenance funds audit, TB test guidance.
- **UAE & Gulf Visas**: 30/60 days express tourist visa issuance, express processing.
- **Umrah & Saudi Visas**: 1-Year Multiple Entry Tourist e-Visas, luxury hotel bookings in Makkah & Madinah.
